subject: Re: CloudNova pricing ask — licensing anchors and transit credit options
messages:
From: Alyssa Tang <alyssa.tang@cloudnova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Competitive pricing request and questions on credits/packaging

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the metrics on caching behavior. We’re doing a parallel evaluation against AeroScale; procurement asked me to run a short economic check to see if Redwood can match the pricing posture we were quoted. A few specific asks from my side: 

- Can you provide a clear seat-based vs consumption-based comparator (list price, expected effective price at our forecasted 1.2B tokens/mo)?
- We were quoted a 12-month commit with a 15% discount by the competitor; can Redwood match that on an equivalent commitment?
- Transit/egress credits: our current vendor offered 6 months of transit credits (to help offset migration egress). Is that something you can provide or replicate?
- Any limits/penalties around term-flex (we may need to shorten to 9 months in the event of a platform decision mid-year).

Procurement attached our RFP (CloudNova_RFP_v3.pdf). We’d like a short economics note and a proposed commercial structure by end of day Friday so we can present to our finance committee next week.

Appreciate your help — happy to jump on a 30-min call if that’s easier.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Tang
Director, Cloud Platforms
CloudNova

Subject: Re: Competitive pricing request and questions on credits/packaging

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the RFP. I looped in a few folks on commercial and product to make sure we respond with practicable options. High-level plan: we’ll give you three discrete offers (seat-first bundle, committed consumption, and a hybrid runway) with explicit migration/transit credit treatments so your finance committee can compare apples-to-apples. 

Quick clarifying items for your team so our numbers align:
- Is the 1.2B tokens/mo a steady-state forecast starting month 2 of the contract, or does that include a ramp from a smaller pilot?
- Any minimum performance SLO bands required (p50/p95) that should be in the deal?

I’ll send an internal draft shortly (attaching a redline-pricing-playbook.xlsx for internal use). Expect a consumer-facing one-page summary and a recommended negotiation anchor by EOD Friday PST.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Vanessa — quick thoughts from a commercial sizing perspective:

- Anchor on three clear comparators: 12-month seat bundle (discounted), 12-month committed tokens (with step-down overcommit tiers), and a 6+6 hybrid (pilot + commit).
- Transit credit structure we can offer: one-time migration credit equal to estimated egress for first 3 months plus a targeted transit credit for months 4–6 capped at $X (we should compute exact egress cost given their forecast). If they need 6 months full coverage like competitor, we can extend but should trade for a modest uplift or a shorter cancellation window.
- Licenses vs usage: offer price-protection language (freeze list price for 12 months) to reduce their mid-term risk; if they insist on 9-month flexibility, limit the right to one early termination with a pro-rated buyout.

I can run the effective price math if you confirm steady-state vs ramp. Also, recommend we thread in legal after Alyssa responds to the anchor they prefer.

— Jonas
VP, Commercial Strategy

Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial options for CloudNova — short summary and next steps

Alyssa / Procurement team — thanks for the patience. Below are three commercial options that map to the items in your RFP. I’ve kept each option succinct so finance can plug in your forecast. I also attached a one-page summary (proposal-summary-CLD047.pdf).

Option A — Seat-first, annual term (Anchor)\- Structure: 12-month term, seat bundle covering up to X concurrent seats + usage overage at metered rate\- Discount: 14% off list for a 12-month commitment (matchable to 15% with a small onboarding credit trade)\- Credits: One-time migration credit equal to estimated egress for months 1–3; additional transit assistance for months 4–6 capped at $20k\- Term-flex: 9-month voluntary term reduction allowed once with a 30% pro-rated buyout on committed value\- Good for: predictable headcount-aligned teams that value price stability

Option B — Committed consumption (Preferred for forecasted volume)\- Structure: 12-month committed tokens (1.2B tokens/mo steady-state) with tiered step-down pricing if consumption exceeds thresholds\- Discount/Effective price: (we’ll provide modeled effective $/1k tokens based on your forecast)\- Credits: Full egress migration credit for months 1–3; if you require 6 months full egress coverage, we can extend to months 1–6 in exchange for a 3% price uplift or a 9-month minimum notice\- Term-flex: price protection for 12 months; early exit allowed with buyout equal to 50% of remaining committed value\- Good for: teams with predictable token consumption and desire to minimize unit cost

Option C — Hybrid runway (Pilot + Commit)\- Structure: 3-month pilot (discounted seat bundle + limited consumption) followed by option to convert to a 9–12 month commit at pre-agreed pricing\- Credits: Pilot includes a fixed $15k migration credit; conversion includes a capped transit assistance schedule to month 6\- Good for: teams wanting low initial risk and smoother operational handoff

Next steps: 
1) Tell us which option you want modeled (A, B, or C) and confirm if 1.2B tokens/mo is steady-state or includes ramp.
2) We’ll return a one-page financial comparison and effective $/1k tokens (including credits) within 24 hours of your choice.
3) If you want a signature-ready commercial term, we can follow with an abbreviated SOW and legal redline.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min call Thurs 10–12 PST — propose Thu 06/24 10:30am?

Thanks again,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
